description: All candidates for Belmont County District 4 and 8 were invited to a candidate forum on September 2, 2026 at the Belmont High School in Belmont, NH. Candidates were asked questions submitted by voters that attended the forum. The forum was sponsored by Citizens for Belknap County and the NH League of Women Voters. Three democrat and three republican candidates were invited to attend but only the democrats showed up.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Don House, Don House, Fiscal agent © 2020 by Don House
title: Don House participates in Sept 2 Candidate Forum
